verdict.rationale: Sentry provides a documented MCP server (sentry-mcp) enabling AI agents to search errors, analyze performance/traces, and triage issues, plus a documented REST API for managing/exporting data and OTLP ingestion for traces/logs, all of which give an external agent programmatic access to metrics, logs, and traces for debugging. missing for 10: no OpenAPI spec discoverable (probe found 404s), and no independent/hands-on evidence confirming real-world agent usage of these APIs for production debugging.
